It would net to zero for governmental funds either way.

Page 1 is scanned at a slant, so the values sit between label rows. I matched rows using line 17 (102,294.80 + 19,403.02 + 45.69 + 1,662.62 + 5.43 = 123,411.56) and the column 3 sums. The extracted line assignment is consistent with that.
